Rule 4 clause d mein family ke chaar limbs hain. Pehla: spouse aur do surviving unmarried children ya stepchildren, jo wholly dependent hon. Spouse par dependency test nahi lagta. Eligible children saath rehte hon ya na rehte hon. FAQ legally adopted children ka bhi zikr karti hai. Doosra: divorced, abandoned, separated ya widowed daughters, jo employee ke saath rehti hon aur wholly dependent hon. Teesra: wholly dependent parents aur step parents, chahe employee ke saath rehte hon ya nahi, 2025 guidelines ke mutabiq. Chautha: unmarried minor brothers aur unmarried, divorced, abandoned, separated ya widowed sisters. Unko saath rehna aur wholly dependent hona hai. Unke parents zinda na hon ya khud employee par wholly dependent hon. Minor condition brothers par lagti hai. Har relation ki conditions alag check karein.

Do surviving children ki restriction ke teen exceptions hain. Pehla: jin employees ke 20 October 1997 se pehle do se zyada children the. Doosra: restriction ke ek saal ke andar born children. Is window ki exact last date verify karein. Teesra: second childbirth mein multiple births ke kaaran children ki sankhya do se zyada ho. Normally family mein ek wife included hai. Lekin do legally wedded wives hon aur doosri marriage Government ki specific permission se hui ho, to second wife bhi included ho sakti hai. FAQ do eldest surviving unmarried children ka zikr karti hai. FAQ ke mutabiq 25 saal se bada unmarried son ya daughter bhi wholly dependent hone par eligible ho sakta hai, subject to other conditions.

Wholly dependent ka test: 2025 DoPT FAQ ke mutabiq family member ki sab sources se income, including pension, minimum pension plus us par Dearness Relief se zyada nahi honi chahiye. Equal amount bhi is test mein aata hai. Spouse par dependency condition nahi lagti. FAQ ne minimum pension ka seven CPC figure nau hazaar rupaye per month bataya. Official order ke mutabiq 1 January 2026 se Dearness Relief sixty percent hai. Agar dono inputs claim ki relevant date par applicable hon, to example calculation chaudah hazaar chaar sau rupaye per month hai. Ye date-specific calculation hai, permanent notified LTC amount nahi. Baad ke official orders aur claim date verify karein.

Family ki residence conditions relation ke hisaab se badalti hain. Spouse aur eligible unmarried children ke liye saath rehna zaroori nahi. 2025 guidelines ke mutabiq wholly dependent parents aur step parents ke liye bhi residence condition nahi. Eligible divorced, abandoned, separated ya widowed daughters aur eligible siblings ke liye residence aur dependency dono check honge. FAQ ke mutabiq parents in law aur grandparents family mein included nahi hain. Specified daughters aur sisters ke children bhi excluded dikhaye gaye hain. Door rehti family ki journeys ke liye origin, destination, direction aur applicable fare order alag se verify karein. Different compilations mein explanation numbering alag ho sakti hai; source aur content dhyan se dekhein.

Family FAQs ka rapid revision. Pachis saal se bada unmarried son ya daughter, wholly dependent hone par eligible ho sakta hai. In laws eligible nahi hain. Eligible family members alag groups, times aur destinations par travel kar sakte hain, applicable rules ke saath. Door rehta spouse aur eligible children conditions ke subject LTC le sakte hain. Private sector spouse ke liye FAQ mein di gayi clarification padhein aur double reimbursement assume na karein. FAQ ke mutabiq five years se chhote child ke separate train berth ka reimbursement allowed nahi. Non air entitled employee ke under five child ke air fare par restriction aur special dispensation exception bhi check karein. Suspension mein employee khud LTC nahi le sakta, lekin eligible family le sakti hai.

Ab special cases aur family journeys. Study leave ya training abroad ki journey aur fare treatment ke liye original applicable order aur competent office se confirmation lein. Specified hometown marriage case mein naye spouse ki hometown se employee ke headquarters tak one way journey allow ho sakti hai. Leave preparatory to retirement mein return journey leave expire hone se pehle complete honi chahiye. Door rehne wali family ki residence se travel aur family ke headquarters tak travel ke instructions alag hain. FAQ questions 74 aur 75 hometown aur any place journeys ki counting samjhati hain. Har claim mein origin, destination, travel direction, chosen LTC aur applicable reimbursement order alag verify karein.

Rule 5: employee hometown declare kare aur Controlling Officer accept kar le, to declaration final maana jaata hai. Exceptional circumstances mein Head of Department change authorise kar sakta hai. Agar employee khud Head of Department hai, to Administrative Ministry change authorise kar sakti hai. Rule ke mutabiq poori service mein aisa change ek se zyada baar nahi hoga. Declaration ki acceptance aur exceptional change do alag functions hain. Hometown ka normal residence test poochta hai: Government service ke kaaran door na rehna padta, to employee normally kis jagah rehta? Official decision visits for obligations, residential property, near relations aur joining se pehle residence jaise criteria batata hai. Applicable instruction aur facts verify karein.

Rule 6: any place in India LTC ke liye intended place of visit, employee ko Controlling Officer ke saamne advance mein declare karna hota hai. 3 September 2025 ke DoPT guidelines mein change aur relaxation ke text mein journey se pehle shabd dono jagah aata hai, isliye wording ambiguous hai. Older official compilation mein wording different hai. Guidelines ke disclaimer ke mutabiq contradiction ya imprecision mein relevant order prevail karta hai. Isliye applicable order aur competent authority se written clarification lein. Relaxation ko automatic mat samjhein. Hometown ke Rule 5 aur any place ki advance declaration ke Rule 6 ko mix na karein.

Government instructions aur decisions ka recap. Rule 1 ke notes mein deputation aur industrial staff ki conditions dekhein. Rule 4 mein dependency benchmark, spouse exemption aur family journeys ke separate instructions check karein. Marriage aur leave preparatory to retirement ki specific conditions alag hain. Rule 5 mein normal residence, declaration acceptance aur exceptional change ki authority important hain. Border area ke local restrictions aur self controlling officer ke declaration procedure ke liye applicable official instructions dekhein. Kisi purane compilation mein instruction chhapa hona guarantee nahi ki woh aaj unchanged hai. Original order, later amendments aur case ke facts ko saath mein verify karein.

Ab final practice. Rule 1 ke mutabiq rules kab force mein aaye? Jawab: Official Gazette mein publication ki date se. Dependency test se kaun exempt hai? Jawab: spouse. Hometown declaration kaun accept karta hai? Jawab: Controlling Officer. Exceptional hometown change ki authority kaun? Head of Department, ya specified case mein Administrative Ministry. Rule 6 ki advance declaration kis concession ke liye hai? Any place in India LTC. Leave preparatory to retirement mein kya condition hai? Return journey leave expire hone se pehle complete honi chahiye. Iske saath Rules 1 se 6 ka recreated video complete hota hai. Ye study material hai, legal advice nahi. Claim se pehle latest applicable official orders aur competent authority ki clarification check karein. Dhanyavaad!
